Which secular resonance state does a record show?

Source: R/resonance_state.R
resonance_state.Rd

Which secular resonance state does a record show?

Usage

resonance_state(ecc_kyr, obl_kyr, max_ratio = 4, data_dir = NULL)

Arguments

ecc_kyr

Measured period of the long eccentricity modulation (the "2.4 Myr" cycle, g4-g3), in kyr (numeric, > 0, e.g. 2400). Required, no default.

obl_kyr

Measured period of the obliquity modulation (the "1.2 Myr" cycle, s4-s3), in kyr (numeric, > 0, e.g. 1200). Required, no default.

max_ratio

Largest integer p and q considered when searching the simple ratio p:q closest to the measured frequency ratio f(obliquity modulation) / f(eccentricity modulation) (integer, >= 1). Default=4.

data_dir

Directory that contains the data file La04gisi.csv with the La2004 secular frequencies used for the modern values (character path). NULL uses the data installed with the package (or options(cocoR.data)). Default=NULL.

Value

list: the implied frequencies, their ratio, the nearest simple resonance, the resonance argument (arcsec/yr and as a period), and the modern values for comparison
